beaches.name: Hanlan's Point Beach
beaches.summary: The whole of Hanlan's Point Beach is clothing-optional. The City of Toronto beaches page states "This beach is clothing-optional"; council made a roughly 1,000 m section on the western shore permanent in 2002 and in 2023 voted to make all of the beach clothing-optional. Lifeguards supervise daily in season from 10:30 to 19:00.
